structure types.name: data

fields.name: block number
constraints: block numbers begin with one and increase by one.

fields.name: data
constraints: if length is 512 bytes, the block is not the last block.
if length is 0 to 511 bytes, it signals the end of the transfer.
the payload length (data) must be deterministically calculated based on the total packet size minus 4 bytes (opcode + block #).
the packet size can range from 4 bytes (if data is 0 bytes) up to 516 bytes (if data is 512 bytes).

structure types.name: ack

fields.name: block number
constraints: echoes the block number of the data packet being acknowledged.
if a wrq is acknowledged, the block number is zero.
the basic ack structure is 4 bytes (opcode + block # + padding).
the total length of the ack packet is generally 4 bytes, but potentially includes padding.

structure types.name: error

fields.name: error code
constraints: error code indicates the nature of the error. defined values include 1 (file not found), 2 (access violation), etc.

fields.name: error message
constraints: intended for human consumption, terminated with a zero byte.
minimum required size is 4 bytes (opcode + errorcode).
the length of the packet is 2 bytes (opcode) + 2 bytes (errorcode) + length of errormsg.
